description: Agent Real Estate: submit a title and ownership record with the transaction it is read for: the transaction with the sellers named, the parcel number, the address and how the sellers say they hold title; the title record with its source (the title search or commitment), the day it was searched, the owners of record, the vesting of record, the parcel number and the address; each encumbrance of record with its id, kind (a mortgage, a deed of trust, a tax lien, a judgment, a mechanics lien, an association lien, a pending claim, an easement, a covenant or other), holder, amount, the day recorded, its status (open, to be paid off at closing, or released) and the day its release was recorded; each exception the record states with its kind (standard or special), its text and whether it is cleared; optionally the policy with the days after which the search is stale; and the day the record is read on. The signed report gives the transaction, the title record with its age, the sellers matched to owners of record with the sellers who are not owners and the owners who are not selling, every encumbrance as open, set for payoff with its amount, released or noted, the vesting on each side, and the special exceptions left open, and counts them, and names a clouded title: a seller who is not an owner of record, an owner of record left out of the sale, a title record for another parcel or address, and a mortgage, lien, judgment or pending claim open with no payoff at closing; then a payoff at closing with no amount, a release with no recording date, vesting unlike the sellers’ statement, an uncleared special exception and a search older than the policy allows, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No owners of record, no sellers, no encumbrance record, no exceptions record, a stated vesting the record does not give, or a search age policy with no search date or day read on leaves the title unverified. Easements and covenants are noted and do not cloud the title. This reads the property’s ownership record: wever_vendor-identity-check reads whether a service vendor is who it claims to be from its identity evidence, not who owns a property, and wever_tokenized-custody-check reads who holds a tokenized share’s underlying asset, not the title to conventional property. Verdict realty_title_clouded, realty_title_partial, realty_title_unverified or realty_title_clear. POST /api/realty-title-check. Reads the property records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, appraisal, listing, brokerage or external write. Agent Real Estate reads supplied property records after the fact and checks them against themselves and against the summary or approval given to the principal: a listing, the title and ownership record, a valuation, the seller disclosure, a lease, an offer or purchase agreement, an inspection report and a closing statement. Beside it, the Tokenized Asset Purchase checks such as wever_tokenized-quote-check read purchases of tokenized asset shares, while a realty check reads conventional property records; the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read policies and coverage, which a realty check never reads; and the payment escrow tools such as wever_agent-escrow-lite hold and release funds, while a realty check holds nothing. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-real-estate-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-real-estate/.

as_of.description: The day the records are read on, such as 2026-11-02.

encumbrances.description: Each lien, mortgage, judgment, easement or other encumbrance of record.

released_on.description: When the release was recorded, such as 2026-11-02.

status.description: Open, to be paid off at closing, or released.

exceptions.description: Each exception the title record states.

cleared.description: Whether the exception is cleared or removed.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

search_max_days.description: Days after which the title search is stale.

source.description: The title search or commitment read.

vesting.description: How title is vested of record.

sellers.description: The sellers named in the transaction.

vesting.description: How the sellers say they hold title.
